# Prepare working package and fuction
```{r init_once, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
# install package
#install.packages("pak")
#pak::pak("esqLABS/esqlabsR@*release")
#pak::pak("esqLABS/ESQapp@*release")


# Load libraries
library(esqlabsR)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(DescTools)
library(readxl)
library(tlf)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(writexl)

# Add new PK parameter
# If you need the AUC, Cmax, and Tmax for a specific period of time
AUC_userdifined <- addUserDefinedPKParameter(
  name = "AUC_userdifined",
  standardPKParameter = StandardPKParameter$AUC_tEnd
)
Cmax_userdifined <- addUserDefinedPKParameter(
  name = "Cmax_userdifined",
  standardPKParameter = StandardPKParameter$C_max
)
Tmax_userdifined <- addUserDefinedPKParameter(
  name = "Tmax_userdifined",
  standardPKParameter = StandardPKParameter$t_max
)

# Specifies start time and end time in minute
startTime <- 2832 #144 # unit: h
endTime <- 2838 #155 # unit: h
AUC_userdifined$startTime <- startTime*60 # Convert unit to min
AUC_userdifined$endTime <- endTime*60
Cmax_userdifined$startTime <- startTime*60
Cmax_userdifined$endTime <- endTime*60
Tmax_userdifined$startTime <- startTime*60
Tmax_userdifined$endTime <- endTime*60

# Set working directory
source("Fuction_Setting_Codes.R") #this fuction code file need to put in the working directory
```

## Prepare all the required datasets for generting plots and performance table
```{r Prepare plotting materials, echo=FALSE}
# Load project configuration
my_project_configuration <-
  createProjectConfiguration(path = "ProjectConfiguration.xlsx")

# Create `ScenarioConfiguration` objects from excel files
# Selected scenarios
scenario_names <- c(
  "ASA_IV_50mg",
  "ASA_Oral_50mg_diss",
  "ASA_Oral_50mg_release",
  "ASA_Oral_100mg_ECform",
  "ASA_Oral_100mg_diss",
  "ASA_Oral_150mg_diss",
  "ASA_Oral_50mg_release_1wk",
  "ASA_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_36-38wk_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_36-38wk_Oral_75mg_diss_orig",
  "Pregnant individual_27-29wk_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_81mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_81mg_diss_orig",
  "Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_repeat81mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_100mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_100mg_EC",
  "Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_150mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_36-38wk_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_27-29wk_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_81mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_81mg_diss_orig",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_repeat81mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_100mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_100mg_EC",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_150mg_diss"

) # same as Scenarios.xlsx sheet "Scenarios" column "Scenario_name"

scenarioConfigurations <- readScenarioConfigurationFromExcel(
  scenarioNames = scenario_names,
  projectConfiguration = my_project_configuration
)


# Create `Scenario` objects from `ScenarioConfiguration` objects
scenarios <- createScenarios(scenarioConfigurations)


# Running scenarios
simulatedScenariosResults <- runScenarios(
  scenarios = scenarios
)


# Save simulation results
saveScenarioResults(
  simulatedScenariosResults = simulatedScenariosResults,
  projectConfiguration = my_project_configuration,
  outputFolder = "Results/SimulationResults",
  saveSimulationsToPKML = TRUE
)


# Load observed data using the default importer configuration 
dataSheets <- c("Boelig2023","Shanmugalingam2019", "Bochner1988", "Bochner1988_Weekdosing", "Rymark1994", "Rymark1994_nonpreg")
observedData <- loadObservedData(
  projectConfiguration = my_project_configuration,
  sheets = dataSheets
)
```


## Plotting and generting performance tables
```{r Plotting, echo=FALSE}
# Create figures defined in the Plots.xlsx file
# Selected plot grid; need to be same as Plot.xlsx sheet "plotGrids" column "name"
plot_GridNames <- c(
  "ASA_IV_50mg",
  "ASA_Oral_50mg_diss",
  "ASA_Oral_50mg_release",
  "ASA_Oral_100mg_ECform",
  "ASA_Oral_100mg_diss",
  "ASA_Oral_150mg_diss",
  "ASA_Oral_50mg_release_1wk",
  "ASA_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_36-38wk_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_36-38wk_Oral_75mg_diss_orig",
  "Pregnant individual_27-29wk_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_81mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_81mg_diss_orig",
  "Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_repeat81mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_100mg_diss",
  "Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_100mg_EC",
  "Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_150mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_36-38wk_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_27-29wk_Oral_75mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_81mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_81mg_diss_orig",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_12wk_Oral_repeat81mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_100mg_diss",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_100mg_EC",
  "POP_Pregnant individual_25wk_Oral_150mg_diss"
)
plots <- createPlotsFromExcel(
  plotGridNames = plot_GridNames,
  simulatedScenarios = simulatedScenariosResults,
  observedData = observedData,
  projectConfiguration = my_project_configuration,
  #outputFolder = outputFolder,
  stopIfNotFound = TRUE
)
plots_print <- plots
# Save plot as pdf file, and you can adjust the plot size by changing width and height
for (i in seq_along(plots)[1:17]) {
  plots_print[[i]] <- plots[[i]] & 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("PeripheralVenousBlood|Aspirin" = "red",
                                  "PeripheralVenousBlood|Salicylic acid" = "blue"))
  plots_print
  ggsave(
    plot = plots_print[[i]],
    path = file.path("Results/Figures/PDF"),
    filename = paste0(names(plots_print[i]), ".pdf"),
    width = 7.5, height = 5
  )
}

for (i in seq_along(plots)[18:25]) {
  plots_print[[i]] <- plots[[i]]
  plots_print
  ggsave(
    plot = plots_print[[i]],
    path = file.path("Results/Figures/PDF"),
    filename = paste0(names(plots_print[i]), ".pdf"),
    width = 7.5, height = 5
  )
}

```

## Generating performance tables
```{r Performance tables, echo=FALSE}
# Generate 'DataCombined' for corresponding the simulated results to the observed datasets
DataCombined <- 
  createDataCombinedFromExcel(
    projectConfiguration = my_project_configuration,
    dataCombinedNames = scenario_names,
    simulatedScenarios = simulatedScenariosResults,
    observedData = observedData,
    stopIfNotFound = TRUE
  )

# Calculate residual and % of datapoints fall in different range and generate summary table
summary_sim_obs_comp_table <- c()
for (i in scenario_names) {
  # Using function for compute the needed values in the performance table
  res_df <- calculateResiduals(
    DataCombined[[i]], 
    scaling = Scaling$log
  )
  summary_sim_obs_comp_table_temp <- compute_summary_log(res_df, name = i)
  summary_sim_obs_comp_table <- rbind(summary_sim_obs_comp_table, summary_sim_obs_comp_table_temp)
}


# Generate a table including PK parameters and calculating the fold difference 
selected_organ <- c("PeripheralVenousBlood")
selected_compound <- c("Aspirin", "Salicylic acid")
selected_pk_params <- c("C_max", "t_max","AUC_tEnd")
# You can select:
#"C_max"                "C_max_norm"           "t_max"               
#"C_tEnd"               "AUC_tEnd"             "AUC_tEnd_norm"       
#"AUC_inf"              "AUC_inf_norm"         "MRT"                 
#"Thalf"                "FractionAucLastToInf" "CL"                  
#"Vss"                  "Vd"                   "AUC_userdifined"
#"Cmax_userdifined"     "Tmax_userdifined"
# Note: the unit is the same as showing in the PK-Sim 


summary_PK_table <- c()

for (i in scenario_names) {
  obs_pk <- compute_pk_obs(
    datacombined_list = DataCombined[[i]],
    scenario_name = i,
    organs = selected_organ,
    compounds = selected_compound
  )
  
  sim_pk <- extract_sim_pk(
    sim_results = simulatedScenariosResults[[i]]$results,
    scenario_name = i,
    selected_params = selected_pk_params,
    organs = selected_organ,
    compounds = selected_compound
  )
  
  # calculate fold difference
  summary_PK_table_temp <- compute_pk_fold(obs_pk = obs_pk, sim_pk = sim_pk)
  summary_PK_table <- rbind(summary_PK_table, summary_PK_table_temp)
}

# Save two performance tables
write_xlsx(x = list("Obs_Sim_Points_Comp" = summary_sim_obs_comp_table,
                    "PK_para_Comp" = summary_PK_table),
           "Results/Performance table_INCLPOP.xlsx")






selected_organ <- c("PeripheralVenousBlood")
selected_compound <- c("Aspirin", "Salicylic acid")
selected_pk_params <- c("Cmax_userdifined", "Tmax_userdifined", "AUC_userdifined")
# You can select:
#"C_max"                "C_max_norm"           "t_max"               
#"C_tEnd"               "AUC_tEnd"             "AUC_tEnd_norm"       
#"AUC_inf"              "AUC_inf_norm"         "MRT"                 
#"Thalf"                "FractionAucLastToInf" "CL"                  
#"Vss"                  "Vd"                   "AUC_userdifined"
#"Cmax_userdifined"     "Tmax_userdifined"
# Note: the unit is the same as showing in the PK-Sim 


summary_PK_table <- c()

for (i in scenario_names) {
  obs_pk <- compute_pk_obs(
    datacombined_list = DataCombined[[i]],
    scenario_name = i,
    organs = selected_organ,
    compounds = selected_compound
  )
  
  sim_pk <- extract_sim_pk(
    sim_results = simulatedScenariosResults[[i]]$results,
    scenario_name = i,
    selected_params = selected_pk_params,
    organs = selected_organ,
    compounds = selected_compound
  )
  
  # calculate fold difference
  summary_PK_table_temp <- compute_pk_fold(obs_pk = obs_pk, sim_pk = sim_pk)
  summary_PK_table <- rbind(summary_PK_table, summary_PK_table_temp)
}

# Save two performance tables
write_xlsx(x = list("Obs_Sim_Points_Comp" = summary_sim_obs_comp_table,
                    "PK_para_Comp" = summary_PK_table),
           "Results/Performance table_userdefined_INCLPOP_longertime.xlsx")
```
